svg.text: Zoom 3 · one row: layer 3's keys and values
8 cells of 16 KiB: a K and a V for each of the 4 KV heads, 128 KiB in all. The model has 24 query heads; each group of 6 shares one KV head
who reads them: 24 query heads, 6 per KV head
read K head 0 and V head 0
read K head 1 and V head 1
read K head 2 and V head 2
read K head 3 and V head 3
So a token stores 4 keys + 4 values per full layer, not 24 + 24: 16 layers × 8 × 512 B = 64 KiB per token.
